column1: sk->sk_dst_cache is currently protected by a rwlock (sk_dst_lock)
This rwlock is readlocked for a very small amount of time
entries are already freed after RCU grace period. This calls for RCU
This patch converts sk_dst_lock to a spinlock
__sk_dst_get() is supposed to be called with rcu_read_lock() or if
This patch avoids two atomic ops per tx packet on UDP connected sockets

column2: and permits sk_dst_lock to be much less dirtied.
